feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)

US3.note: Two coupled changes forced by the owner feed decision: removing the probe removes the series inductance that matched US3 in band, so the patch resonance (fit fr 7.581 GHz, below the band) is moved to f0. Material, h, board, W and the U-slot polygon (Wu, Lu, t, y0) are unchanged.

rationale: US3_MS1: US3 re-fed per owner decision 2026-11-05 (no SMA/coax probe). Circuit fit of US3 fine/xfine (em/circuit_fits/US3_*_fit_7to9GHz.json: Zin = R0 + jwLs + R/(1+jQ(f/fr-fr/f)), fr 7.581/7.583 GHz, Q 13.75, R 142-143 ohm, Ls 1.83-1.97 nH) shows the in-band match came from the ideal-probe inductance acting on a resonance below the band. A microstrip inset feed has no such series inductance, so L is scaled by fr_fit/f0 (6.85 -> 6.501 mm) to centre the patch resonance on f0 (first-order cavity scaling, estimate). Inset depth from the cos^2 inset law anchored on the fit: R(probe at 1.096 mm from the edge) ~ 142 ohm -> R_edge ~ 142/cos^2(pi*1.096/6.85) ~ 185 ohm; R(d) = 50 ohm at d ~ 2.1 mm for L 6.5 mm; d = 2.0 mm (R est ~ 60 ohm) keeps 0.55 mm of metal between the inset tip (y -1.2505) and the U-slot base (y -0.7). Guide estimate only: notches and the U-slot perturb the cos^2 law; no S11 is claimed. With Q ~ 13.75 the guide model predicts VSWR 3 fractional bandwidth ~ 2/(Q sqrt3) ~ 8.4 % (> 6.25 % channel) only if the resonance is centred: not a result.

computation.method: Hammerstad-Jensen microstrip; cavity scaling of L by the EM-fitted fr; cos^2 inset law anchored on the US3 circuit fit. GEOMETRY_ONLY.
